text:
elaine_partners: starting a thread to propose a 'mini-module quickstart' playbook for cloud partners. idea: tiny opinionated terraform modules + 1-click demo app + marketplace packaging. goal = partner-ready examples that are easy to review and publish.
samir_devx: love it. call out expectations: 1) demo deploys in <30m, 2) clear minimal perms doc, 3) tag + billing metadata baked in.
toni_infra: keep modules focused: single responsibility, <= 6 resources, expose vars: env, region (aliasable), instance_type, common_tags. HCL only, prefer minimal provider versioning. add a small compatibility manifest.
gina_eng: repo pattern proposal: `mini-modules/<service>/` with `examples/{aws,gcp,azure}/demo/` and `ci/publish.yml`. each module must include terraform-docs output and LICENSE/MAINTAINERS. docs should include a short CLI quickstart and a table of supported regions.
yasmine_pm: partners care about branding + co-marketing hooks. include a short Partner Info block in README with suggested partner logo size and suggested demo text.
matt_sre: CI must include apply -> run smoke health check -> destroy. Use ephemeral creds and ensure destroy on failure. prefer using our smoke-runner image and include retry/backoff for API calls.
jordan_ci: CI flow suggestion:
- tflint + terraform fmt check
- terraform init && plan -out=plan.tfplan
- terraform apply -auto-approve
- run smoke container that queries module output endpoint (HTTP/HTTPS)
- terraform destroy -auto-approve
Matrix: separate jobs per cloud example to isolate creds; run on ubuntu-latest with arch matrix [x86_64, arm64].
elaine_partners: for marketplace publishing: need an artifact (zip) that contains module, example, generated docs, compat.yml, and a short metadata file (support_email, billing_tag, recommended_sku). recommend Redwood handles initial publish and provides partner with a publish wrapper script.
toni_infra: compat.yml should list supported regions, architectures, and tested provider versions. include `compat-check.sh` to validate terraform version and run a quick provider resolution check. small script, POSIX sh.
samir_devx: snippet we should include in every README for quickstart usage:
```terraform
variable "region" { type = string }
variable "common_tags" { type = map(string) }
provider "aws" { region = var.region }
resource "aws_instance" "app" {
  ami           = var.ami
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  tags = merge(var.common_tags, { Name = "mini-${var.env}" })
}
output "public_ip" { value = aws_instance.app.public_ip }
```
gina_eng: publishing workflow idea: `ci/publish.yml` builds zip, runs terraform-docs, uploads to staging bucket, then calls infra-bot to register artifact. naming convention: `{service}-{commit}-{shortsha}.zip`. include checksum file.
infra-bot: [automation] created staging artifact: gs://redwood-marketplace-staging/mini-modules/http-forwarder-1784623456-0a1b2c3.zip (sha256: d4735e3a).
jordan_ci: timeline proposal: prototype repo + CI by Thu, cross-cloud examples by next Tue, partner review by following Thu. owners: samir_devx (program lead), gina_eng (CI + repo), toni_infra (compat scripts), elaine_partners (partner docs + marketing hooks), yasmine_pm (partner comms).
matt_sre: add SRE checklist to README: rollback instructions, quota troubleshooting, Dedicated fallback link, and where to find logs. label issues that are partner-blocking.
elaine_partners: will prepare `partners/PARTNER_CHECKLIST.md` with items: expected demo time, support contact, billing_tag example, marketing blurb, and co-publishing steps.
samir_devx: question: canonical repo or partner forks? proposal: canonical repo `redwood/mini-modules` maintained by Redwood; partners fork and brand. Redwood performs curated marketplace publishes and provides partner with a `publish-pack` to run one-off updates.
yasmine_pm: we'll coordinate announcement cadence with GTM once we have at least 3 partner quickstarts in the repo. prefer soft-launch to partner channels first.
gina_eng: will draft a starter `http-forwarder` mini-module and open a PR today. CI will have a smoke job that runs only on PR for maintainers to review.
infra-bot: [automation] PR created: https://github.com/redwood/mini-modules/pull/12 (http-forwarder).
jordan_ci: reminder: ensure all example outputs are deterministic for smoke test lookups (e.g. use output.public_ip).
matt_sre: add destroy-on-timeout guard in workflows and export logs on failure for debugging.
samir_devx: great progress. small ask: keep README short and include a TL;DR at top with 3 bullet steps to get started. will follow up on PR.
elaine_partners: adding partner review slot on next Tue. will ping partners list once PRs are ready. :calendar:
note: playbook thread for partner-facing mini-module quickstarts: packaging, CI, compat, publishing model
